corrects.policy: Historical evidence is immutable; the original file is left unmodified. This record supersedes its conclusion, per RECURSIVE-SELF-CENSUS.md's 'monotonic evidence, revisable conclusions' rule.

original_claim: "The EXISTING, already-validated systemize CLI binary (built before this change existed conceptually, for an unrelated purpose) was run fresh against this repository's real root and inspected directly: census.coverage.BUILD == 'OBSERVED' ... the same stable machinery this repository already trusted for every other census axis, not a check invented alongside the candidate to agree with it." and "no_circular_self_certification: true".
discovered_flaw: `runtime::systemize` calls `adapter::census_cargo_workspace` directly (see `runtime/src/lib.rs`'s `systemize()`). The `systemize` CLI is a thin wrapper around this same function -- there is no second implementation, no second resolution algorithm, and no independently-sourced data behind the CLI's output for this specific capability. Running the CLI and inspecting its dependency_closure field is candidate implementation -> CLI wrapper -> candidate implementation result: the same code path checked against itself through an extra layer of indirection. A bug in `census_cargo_workspace` that produces a self-consistent wrong answer (e.g. every edge subtly misclassified the same way) would pass this check every time, because the 'independent' channel was never independent. This violates RECURSIVE-SELF-CENSUS.md's stable-validator law ("a candidate must never be sole authority proving itself") and its hard invariant against circular self-certification, even though the original evidence record explicitly and sincerely believed it was satisfying that law -- the CLI genuinely was pre-existing and built for an unrelated purpose, which is why the flaw was not obvious without deliberately auditing the call graph.
corrected_interpretation: The dependency-census-cargo-bootstrap generation's SELF-WRITTEN TESTS (including the real-self-census test reading this repository's own actual files) remain valid evidence that the parser does what its own logic intends. But the generation's claim of INDEPENDENT verification was false until this correction: no evidence external to the candidate's own code existed. The generation's overall verdict of 'MATERIALIZED AND VERIFIED FOR THE STATED BOOTSTRAP SCOPE' should be read as 'materialized and self-consistent' for that specific claim, not independently verified, until the replacement evidence below.

replacement_verification.mechanism: adapter/src/dependency/cargo_oracle.rs (test-only, gated `#[cfg(test)] mod cargo_oracle;` in adapter/src/dependency/mod.rs -- never reachable from adapter's own public API or from `census_cargo_workspace`/`systemize`/coding-admission)
replacement_verification.oracle: `cargo metadata --format-version=1 --offline`, Cargo's own dependency resolver, run as a subprocess against this repository's real, already-resolved workspace (no network access; uses the existing Cargo.lock and local registry cache). Shares zero code with adapter/src/dependency/cargo.rs.
replacement_verification.what_it_compares: candidate_parser_agrees_with_cargo_metadata_on_this_repositorys_real_resolved_edges: every (consumer, provider name, provider version) edge triple the candidate parser produced vs. every edge cargo metadata's own resolve.nodes[].deps report, on this repository's real workspace. candidate_parser_agrees_with_cargo_metadata_on_resolved_package_identity: every (name, version) package identity the candidate resolved is a subset of what cargo metadata itself resolved.
replacement_verification.canonical_extractor_vs_oracle_distinctio: Recorded explicitly in cargo_oracle.rs's own module doc comment and in DEPENDENCY-CENSUS.md's Implementation status section: `census_cargo_workspace` (production, pure static parsing, no process execution) != the oracle (test-only, executes `cargo` as a subprocess, never reachable from production code) -- keeping the security boundary this contract requires (`.atlas/contracts/DEPENDENCY-CENSUS.md#build-time-and-dynamic-dependency-discovery`: 'Census is analysis; execution requires separately authorized/sandboxed capability') intact for the real production path.
replacement_verification.falsification_proof_the_oracle_has_teeth: Manually mutated `census_cargo_workspace` to append "-MUTATED" to every edge's consumer name and re-ran the oracle test: it failed immediately with a clear diff showing every mismatched triple. The mutation was then reverted and the full test suite re-confirmed green. This proves the oracle comparison is not vacuously true -- it genuinely depends on the candidate parser's real output.

additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.defect: DependencyClosureReport.is_closed() == dangling_references.is_empty() could not distinguish NotApplicable (no Cargo.lock) from Blocked (malformed lockfile) from a genuinely verified Closed empty graph. runtime::systemize's fallback for the no-Cargo.lock case fabricated a zero-edge report that silently read is_closed() == true, so DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_NOT_CLOSED never fired for a repository where Cargo census never ran at all.
additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.fix: New DependencyClosureState enum (NotApplicable/Blocked/Partial/Closed) replacing the bare boolean; runtime::build_coverage_from_dependency_closure (pure, unit-tested, one falsification case per state transition) derives BUILD coverage and the coding-admission blocker from state, never from default structure values.

additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.defect: classify_source_kind (formerly inline: source.is_some() => Registry, source.is_none() => WorkspaceMember) misclassified a git+ dependency as Registry and any non-workspace path dependency as WorkspaceMember (both lack a source field in Cargo.lock, indistinguishable without cross-referencing real workspace-member evidence).
additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.fix: New DependencySourceKind::Other variant; classify_source_kind now checks the source string's actual prefix (registry+/git+) and cross-references the real, evidenced workspace-member name set (read from the root manifest's own workspace.members) before ever concluding WorkspaceMember for a source-less package. Adversarial fixtures added for git, unrecognized-source, and non-workspace-path-dependency cases.

additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.defect: A multi-line workspace.members array was silently treated identically to 'no workspace declared'. A multi-line inline-table dependency entry (optional = true on a continuation line) was silently misread as if only its first physical line existed.
additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.fix: workspace_members() now returns whether it detected an unparsed multi-line members array, recorded in the new unsupported_constructs field and forcing Partial state. manifest_dependency_entries() now joins a multi-line inline table via brace-depth tracking before classifying it, so optional/rename detection is correct even when the entry spans several physical lines.

additional_hardening_this_correction_bun.defect: A resolved static Cargo.lock/Cargo.toml graph could be read as 'dependency closure verified' with no explicit signal that build.rs, proc-macro expansion, pkg-config, native linking, generated source, environment probes, dynamic loading, plugin discovery, or external-capability dependencies remain entirely unobserved.
